text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership decided to "crouch low" for a 
while, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Care to test our mettle, Rose?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hm, you are—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I have no intention of slacking 
on gathering intel. I'll make sure to 
probe the rivals' hands thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chosen tandem running partner was Rose 
Kingdom from the same generation—an 
Umamusume from the prestigious 'Rose 
Clan.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The "House of Roses." A prestigious 
family tracing its origins to French 
Umamusume nobility—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To forge a new frontier even in Japan, 
where she crossed over to, she continues 
to fight proudly in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If it is a duel you desire— then I accept 
your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I want to show the unyielding spirit of 
the Rose Clan. ――Especially to you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Of course I know how you feel. 
However, it seems that to you—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It seems you fail to see it. The entire 
"board," that is.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The board... entirely?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, those who focus without doubt on 
a single detail will lose sight of the 
whole picture."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"And because of that single-minded 
devotion, you lose. Not to your opponent, 
but to yourself."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see if you've fallen into tunnel 
vision. Come at me—Rose."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Very well. Let us test the authenticity 
of my rose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership competes against Rose Kingdom 
with complete composure. The result is—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: EHHK, SO STRONG!?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It seems the rose—was real after all. Just 
a single blossom, yet truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what on earth is this... It's not even 
a contest... She's just overwhelmingly 
strong...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer!?
choice_data_list:
Hmm, maybe it's the difference... in how 
early they mature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For Umamusume at this stage, precocity is 
tested just as much as talent. If the gap 
there is too wide, there's nothing that 
can be done."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...? I mean, sure, I knew it in 
theory, but with a gap this huge, strategy 
doesn't even matter...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Until then—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"This can't be. This just can't be... 
Right, Rose is an exception. If I run 
against the other peers...!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Ruler-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Eishin Flash. An ultra-meticulous 
Umamusume from Germany.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—It comes down to a battle of late burst! 
With everything I have right now... 
Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—34.4 seconds. It isn't an exceptional 
time, but— it's right on schedule.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... Ahhh, onto the next one, the 
next one!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I would be glad to accompany you. If there 
is even one thing... I can do for 
Ruler-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Victoire Pisa. An angelic Umamusume who 
can't leave lonely people alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, that's brutal!?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please... don't be discouraged. I'll stay 
by your side until you feel better.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What the? She's that strong... that 
gorgeous... and kind on top of all that?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'm losing in every single stat?! What is 
my reason for even living, then?! AAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crushing defeat after crushing defeat... 
It seems the classmate I called out to was 
simply too extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm so done for, waaaah... 
Fine, whatever, I'm quitting right now~~~.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become an eternal resident of an 
online Reversi room...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership's heart looks ready to shatter 
to pieces. What needs to be done at a time 
like this is...
choice_data_list: Time for a SANity check, Ruler!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fear level... check? I see... Guess I'd 
better do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Sanity Check.' A staple of horror 
board games."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Roll the die, and if you pass the check, 
you maintain your sanity. Fail, however... 
and you descend into madness.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Then—let us go!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ready, and...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Torya!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: YAAAY!!!! It's a successssss!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Rulership somehow managed to pull 
himself back from the brink of madness—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks to our promise, I somehow 
managed to keep my sanity. But still...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We've been put in our place... Reminded 
that we're nothing more than a "frontier 
backwater."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you see that a lot in historical 
simulation games, right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The large nation at the center of the map 
has fertile land, giving it an advantage 
from the start of the game.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We have plenty of grain and high-stat 
vassal units. On the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A tiny border nation produces barely any 
grain and has no soldiers... Talk about 
starting on hard mode.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yet, it wasn't total despair. Because—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're at a disadvantage at the 
start, there's always a winning path. 
Otherwise, it wouldn't be much of a game.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My position is clear. For now, I should 
focus on gathering my options.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
For a while, we'll focus on "domestic 
affairs." Let's steadily build up our 
national strength, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the daily grind to overturn 
their unfavorable position.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I'm not one for 
sweating pointlessly, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a waste. If it's for the 
necessary resources, this much is 
nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, whew*... That clears all the 
planned steps.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer. We could challenge 
someone to a mock race to test our current 
strength, but... what do you think?
choice_data_list:
Hmm... wouldn't they be discouraged if 
they lose?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I see. Well, that makes sense... 
Mental stamina is an important resource, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll pass. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... We truly are a "small frontier 
nation" after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There are no soldiers. There is no grain. 
Even so, in hopes of turning the tides, 
the small frontier nation—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"A strong warrior, or perhaps a wise 
commander. One of them is always stationed 
there."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if I have nothing else, I have you! 
You who know board games inside out and 
play with me. Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: That's why...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait, no...! Don't throw that 
awaaay!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare betray me and go to another 
Umamusume's camp, okay!? That's such a 
classic trope for disloyal tacticians!
choice_data_list: I-I won't do anything, don't worry...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's fine... If so, then it's 
fine...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this, Trainer. Until the 
Classic tier, we build national strength 
step by step!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The game is still in its opening phase. 
For now, let's make preparations for the 
day we go on the offensive.
